notes.title: Version 1.1 out now!
notes.notes:
Hold onto your butts! It's a patch containing some shiny new stuff and fixes. 
[list]
[*] Game soundtrack is now included in the game files
[*] Changes to the game physics which now allow Reggie to perform a variable height jump
[*] Difficulty tweaks to certain levels
[*] New entries and changes to the bug computer
[*] Fixes to actual bugs
[/list]

To celebrate the game is 50% off until April 27th!

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.notes:
We've seen and felt the anger some players have had with a certain level in the game, a certain morning on Thursday containing some flying killer objects. We want the game to be hard, but not impossibly hard so we've taken them aside and told these flying objects to calm the hell down! 

We also agree that having no music on the level is a little silly, so music has been re-added to the level, but is it me or does it sound a little different?
